name: Emma S. Clark Memorial Library
sub: The Heart of the Three Village Community

hero.alt: Emma S. Clark Memorial Library in Setauket

maps: Emma S. Clark Memorial Library, 120 Main St, Setauket, NY 11733

intro.text: Emma S. Clark Memorial Library opened on October 3, 1892, in the Tudor-style building on Main Street in Setauket, and it serves residents of the Three Village Central School District. Today it is a full-service library for every age: books, eBooks and streaming, programs and classes from newborns to adults, museum passes, a Library of Things, tech help and the Level Up Kitchen Library Cafe. It is open seven days a week.

services.d: Events and classes for newborns through adults, plus drop-in activities for kids.
Borrow books and DVDs, or download eBooks, audiobooks, e-magazines and movies.
Museum Exploration Passes and discounted tickets for attractions from New York City to the East End.
Borrow sewing machines, robots, wifi hotspots and more.
One-on-one technology help, homework and resume help, language learning and self-paced online classes.

reviews.text: Share what you love about Emma Clark so more neighbors discover it.

faq: How do I get a library card?
Start online with the library's Get a Library Card link at livebrary.com/getacard, or call the library at 631-941-4080. The library serves residents of the Three Village Central School District.
Is the library open on holidays?
The library closes on some holidays. Remaining 2026 closings: November 11, November 26 and December 25, with early 3 PM closings on November 25, December 24 and December 31.
Yes. The Level Up Kitchen Library Cafe is open Monday to Friday 10:30 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 4:30 PM and Sunday 10 AM to 4:30 PM.
